info.title: Catchment API
info.description: Postcode catchment, H3 cell and local-authority metrics, with a discoverable metric catalogue, area mappings and organisation-level trial credits. Access must be explicitly enabled for the organisation. This reference describes the current implementation; availability depends on the deployed version.

get.description: Requested catchment metrics and, when selected, separate local-authority fee/occupancy values for the postcode. Supply exactly one of drive_minutes or radius_miles. The request reserves the number of unique metrics; successful non-null values consume one credit each.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: UK postcode. Case and spacing are ignored. Resolved to its centroid in the ONS Postcode Directory.

parameters.name: drive_minutes
parameters.description: Drive-time catchment in minutes. Mutually exclusive with `radius_miles`.

parameters.name: radius_miles
parameters.description: Radius catchment in miles, measured in a straight line. Mutually exclusive with `drive_minutes`.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Comma-separated keys supporting catchment or local_authority. At most 50 distinct keys; duplicates and empty entries are removed. The catalogue is filtered by organisation access.

parameters.name: projection_year
parameters.description: Year to project population counts to. Omit for observed values.

x-mint.content:
## Geography

Catchments use cumulative, precomputed H3 resolution-8 bands around the postcode's origin cell. Postcodes in the same cell resolve to the same catchment. Radius is a grid approximation of a circle; drive time uses precomputed road-network bands. No saved-site filters or manually edited catchment boundaries are applied.

The authority lookup uses the postcode point. `local_authority.requested_area` identifies its district; `authority` identifies the social-care authority, often the parent county. A radius crossing several authorities still returns authority metrics for the postcode, not an average across the circle. Each authority value also identifies its actual `reporting_authority`.

## Values and availability

`values` and `metric_details` contain requested catchment keys. Authority keys, when requested, are returned separately in `local_authority.values` and `local_authority.metric_details`. Each metric is available or unavailable; missing data stays null. A valid request can contain both. Values follow the catalogue's rounding and null policy.

Open, non-specialist care homes form the older-person bed supply. Undersupply subtracts each bed category from the same modelled demand and retains negative values for surplus. The three undersupply figures overlap and must not be added together. They exclude planning; permitted and undecided pipeline beds are separate metrics.

Private residential and nursing quoted fees remain separate. Bed-weighted means use each contributing home's total beds, not an observed number of residents paying that fee. Residential fee publication requires at least five homes and 150 covered beds; nursing requires three homes and 100 beds. Below-threshold fees are null, with sample counts and bed coverage in the details. Five years of historical private fees is not available.

## Projection and periods

Without `projection_year`, demand uses the source-population age bands. With it, the postcode centroid is converted to a resolution-8 H3 cell. The projection service selects the LAD with the largest recorded overlap for that cell, and uses its factors for supported population counts and derived demand/undersupply. The same factors apply throughout the catchment. Current published supply, fees, planning and authority figures are unchanged. Missing required factors can make projected metrics unavailable.

`population_projection_year` on demand and undersupply details is null when unprojected. Unprojected undersupply combines source-period demand with current published supply. `data_version` identifies the demographic catchment build; other published datasets are read at request time and are not historical snapshots of that build.

## Credits

The full number of unique requested metrics must be available for reservation. Only usable numeric values in the successful response consume credits, including zero. Unavailable values release their reservation. See the [credit and request rules](/#credits).

get.description: Metric values for one H3 resolution-8 cell. Only keys supporting hex are accepted. Care supply, planning and authority metrics are not supported at this endpoint. Successful non-null requested values consume one credit each.

x-mint.content:
## Geography and values

Values describe the single resolution-8 cell. `cell.latitude` and `cell.longitude` are its centre. Source-area data is apportioned to H3 cells by the existing population/address and area rules. Null values are unavailable. The catalogue identifies which keys support `hex`; catchment-only and authority-only keys return `invalid_request` with `unsupported_metrics`.

## Projection

Without `projection_year`, population values use their source period. With it, supported population counts and their derived metrics use factors for the LAD with the largest recorded overlap with the H3 cell. Other metrics are unchanged. Source periods are not necessarily the current year.

## Credits

One credit is reserved per distinct requested key. Successful numeric values, including zero, consume credits; unavailable values do not. Metadata and internal calculation inputs are not separately charged.

get.description: Returns the H3 cells an area overlaps, with the share of the area in each cell and the share of each cell the area covers. Cells are ordered by `share_of_area`, largest first. This endpoint uses no credits.

x-mint.content:
## Area types

| `type` | Areas | Coverage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `oa` | Output areas: 2021 in England and Wales, 2022 in Scotland | Great Britain |
| `lsoa` | 2021 lower layer super output areas | England and Wales |
| `msoa` | 2021 middle layer super output areas | England and Wales |
| `data_zone` | 2022 data zones | Scotland |
| `intermediate_zone` | 2022 intermediate zones | Scotland |

## Shares

| Field | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| `share_of_area` | Fraction of the area's land that lies in the cell. Summed over an area's cells it is 1, less a small remainder for some coastal areas. |
| `share_of_cell` | Fraction of the cell covered by the area. Summed over a cell's areas of one type it is 1 for a cell wholly on land, and less for a cell partly at sea. |

- Shares are by area, measured on the spheroid. They are not the address-weighted shares used for some metrics.
- Shares are rounded to 6 decimal places.
- Cells are H3 resolution 8, the grid the metrics are built on.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Area code: a letter followed by eight digits. Case is ignored.

404.description: No area of that type has that code.

x-mint.content:
## Catalogue scope

The catalogue is filtered by the organisation's API dataset and metric permissions. `geographies` controls which endpoint can read a key. `local_authority` keys can also be included in a postcode catchment request; they remain authority values in that response.

`period_basis` identifies source-period, current published, mixed population/supply, financial-year or monthly observations. It is not a claim that every dataset is current-year data. `nations: null` means no explicit nation restriction in the catalogue, within the API's overall Great Britain coverage; individual values may still be unavailable.

The static [metric catalogue](/api-reference/metric-catalogue) describes the current full-access set. This endpoint is the discovery contract for your own organisation. Query parameters are ignored. No credits are consumed.

get.description: Requested fee and occupancy values for an ONS district, county or unitary authority code. Districts resolve to their social-care parent authority. No radius or projection year is accepted.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: ONS district, county or unitary authority code. Case and surrounding whitespace are normalized; an unknown authority returns 404.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Comma-separated keys supporting local_authority. At most 50 distinct keys; duplicates and empty entries are removed.

200.description: Local-authority values, availability, periods and credit settlement.

404.description: No district, county or unitary authority exists for the code.

error.message: No local authority was found for this code.

x-mint.content:
## Reporting authority

A district normally resolves to its administrative parent county. A county or unitary code can be requested directly. `requested_area` retains the supplied area and `authority` identifies the resolved social-care authority. Every value's details contain the actual `reporting_authority`; occupancy can use a further published reporting-area resolution.

## Fees

`la_avg_fee_residential_week` and `la_avg_fee_nursing_week` each select their latest usable financial year. The two periods can differ. `source_metadata` preserves source-dependent fee-basis and funding evidence when available. Published tariffs, observed fees and Scottish national contract benchmarks are not automatically comparable. No funding basis should be inferred when detailed metadata is absent. Scottish national benchmarks, when present, retain their national source metadata rather than claiming to be council-specific observed averages.

## Occupancy

`la_occupancy_pct` combines general/dementia residential and nursing beds, excluding specialist/other beds. The residential and nursing keys return the separate categories. Coverage is England only. Each category uses its latest published month across the source dataset; a missing or suppressed authority row in that month returns null with the reporting period. The API does not carry forward an older observation or substitute England's value.

These are authority observations, not occupancy of a radius or an individual care home. No projection year or catchment size is accepted. An existing authority with no available data returns 200 with null values and reasons; an unknown code returns 404.

## Credits

One credit is reserved per unique requested key and consumed only for each usable numeric value returned. Catalogue and geography-mapping endpoints are free.

A valid request reserves one credit per unique requested metric before data is read.

This organisation has insufficient API credits. Contact your administrator for a top-up.

data_version.description: Version of the precomputed demographic catchment. Care supply, fees, planning and authority observations are read from their published datasets at request time; this version does not identify a historical snapshot of those datasets.

projection_year.description: The year population counts were projected to, or null for observed values.

values.description: Only requested metrics for this geography. Null means unavailable; zero can be a usable value.

local_authority.description: Included only when at least one local-authority metric is requested. These values describe the postcode's reporting authority, not the catchment.

cell_count.description: How many grid cells the catchment covers.
How many grid cells the catchment covers.

postcode_terminated_on.description: The date the postcode was retired, or null if it is still in use.

unit.description: Unit identifier supplied by the catalogue, such as count, currency_gbp, percent, pct, index or rank.

domain.description: Metric domain, including affluence, demographics, housing and care.

nations.description: ONS codes of the nations the metric has values for. Null means all of Great Britain.

geographies.description: Supported value geography. local_authority metrics can also be included in postcode catchment requests.

period_basis.description: Temporal basis. source_period does not imply current-year data; source_population_and_current_supply combines source/projected demand with current published supply.

request_id.description: Present on requests handled by an endpoint. The unknown-path 404 response has no request ID.

unknown_metrics.description: The metric keys that were not recognised, when that is the problem.

unsupported_metrics.description: Requested keys unsupported by this endpoint's geography.

required_credits.description: Requested reservation that the available organisation balance cannot cover.

projection_year.description: The year population counts were projected to, or null for observed values.

values.description: Only requested metrics for this geography. Null means unavailable; zero can be a usable value.

share_of_area.description: Fraction of the area's land in the cell.

share_of_cell.description: Fraction of the cell covered by the area.

share_of_area.description: Fraction of the area's land in the cell.

share_of_cell.description: Fraction of the cell covered by the area.

used.description: Credits used by this request. One per distinct usable numeric metric returned by a successful metric request; zero for free endpoints or errors.

remaining.description: Organisation credits available after settlement, excluding other in-flight reservations. Shared by all keys in the organisation.

reason.description: Explanation when the value is unavailable; null for an available value.

period.description: Financial year such as 2024-25 for a fee, or ISO month-start date such as 2026-08-01 for occupancy. Null if unavailable or outside coverage. Catchment details do not include this field.

reporting_authority.description: Authority whose published figure is returned. May differ from the requested district.

source_metadata.description: Source-dependent council-fee evidence. May identify sourceKind, feeBasis, sourceScope, sourceNationCode, effectivePeriod, sourceUrl, nursing contributions and review status. Null when detailed evidence is unavailable; do not infer a funding basis.

sample_count.description: Homes with usable private fees for the care type.

beds_covered.description: Total beds at the homes contributing to that private-fee sample; not a count of beds charged this fee.

population_projection_year.description: Present on demand and undersupply details: selected projection year, or null for source-population demand.

requested_area.description: District containing the postcode, or the direct endpoint's requested district/county/unitary authority.

authority.description: Resolved authority responsible for adult social care. A district normally resolves to its parent county; null if none was found for the postcode.

values.description: Only requested metrics for this geography. Null means unavailable; zero can be a usable value.
